pages.title: INS Udaygiri and INS Himgiri commissioned

facts.text: Date: 26 August 2025 at Visakhapatnam — Nilgiri-class (Project 17A) stealth guided-missile frigates
facts.head: News

facts.text: ⚠ First time two major warships from two different shipyards commissioned together — Udaygiri: MDL Mumbai; Himgiri: GRSE Kolkata
facts.head: News

facts.text: Milestone: Udaygiri is the 100th ship designed by Navy's Warship Design Bureau
facts.head: News

facts.text: Follow-on of: Project 17 (Shivalik-class)

facts.text: Total: 7 ships — 4 MDL, 3 GRSE; INS Nilgiri first (January 2025); remaining 4 within 1.5 years

facts.text: Indigenous content: ~75%, 200+ MSMEs

facts.text: Next: Project 17B — 7 next-gen frigates

facts.text: Result: three targets — two fixed-wing UAVs + one multi-copter drone — destroyed simultaneously

pages.title: ISRO Integrated Air Drop Test (IADT-1) for Gaganyaan

facts.text: Test: ISRO's first Integrated Air Drop Test (IADT-1) — validated parachute-based deceleration system of Gaganyaan crew module

facts.text: How: ~5-tonne dummy crew capsule dropped from an IAF Chinook helicopter; main parachutes deployed in sequence

facts.text: Agencies: IAF, Navy, DRDO, Coast Guard

facts.text: ⚠ Not an orbital flight — uncrewed orbital flights are G1 onwards

facts.text: Done: propulsion systems, ECLSS engineering model, Crew Escape System — five types of motors, TV-D1 precursor; HS200 motors; C32-G stage

pages.title: IISc study — Asgard archaea with two FtsZ genes

facts.text: By: IISc Bengaluru — in The EMBO Journal
facts.head: News

facts.text: Organism: Odinarchaeota (an Asgard archaea) — has two FtsZ genes (OdinFtsZ1, OdinFtsZ2) plus a tubulin-like gene
facts.head: News

facts.text: OdinFtsZ1: straight protofilaments, anchors directly to membranes (bacteria-like)
facts.head: News

facts.text: OdinFtsZ2: spiral ring-like structures, needs adaptor proteins
facts.head: News

facts.text: Methods: phylogenetics, cryo-electron microscopy
facts.head: News

facts.text: Asgard archaea: named after Norse gods (Odin-, Loki-, Thorarchaeota); found in deep-sea sediments; closest living relatives of eukaryotes
facts.head: Background

facts.text: FtsZ: bacterial division protein forming the Z-ring; tubulin is the eukaryotic hallmark
facts.head: Background

facts.text: ⚠ Tubulin is not unique to bacteria — it is eukaryotic
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Disease: Primary Amoebic Meningoencephalitis (PAM) — caused by Naegleria fowleri
facts.head: News

facts.text: 2025: three cases in Kozhikode district — death of a nine-year-old, a three-month-old infected
facts.head: News

facts.text: Kerala fatality: ~25% vs global ~97% (early diagnosis)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Year: 1971; Milestone: First Indian case
facts.head: News

facts.text: Year: 2016; Milestone: Kerala's first case — Alappuzha
facts.head: News

facts.text: Year: 2016–2023; Milestone: only 8 cases
facts.head: News

facts.text: Year: 2023; Milestone: 36 cases, 9 deaths
facts.head: News

facts.text: Year: 2024; Milestone: 14-year-old boy in Kozhikode — first Indian to survive PAM; only 11 survivors globally
facts.head: News

facts.text: Habitat: warm freshwater and soil; thrives up to 46°C
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Route: water through the nose → olfactory nerve → brain
facts.head: Background

facts.text: ⚠ Not communicable; not spread by drinking contaminated water
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Death: within 5–18 days of symptoms
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Drugs: Amphotericin B, Azithromycin, Fluconazole, Rifampin, Miltefosine, Dexamethasone
facts.head: Background

pages.title: US first human case of New World screwworm

facts.text: Confirmed: 24 August 2025 by US HHS and CDC — traveller returning from El Salvador; infestation called myiasis
facts.head: News

facts.text: Fly: Cochliomyia hominivorax ("man-eater") — blue-grey blowfly, native to South America & Caribbean
facts.head: News

facts.text: Eggs: up to 300 at a time, 3,000 in lifetime, in open wounds
facts.head: News

facts.text: US eradication: 1966 via Sterile Insect Technique (SIT); later Mexico (1970s), Central America (2000s); Florida outbreak 2017
facts.head: Background

facts.text: New outbreaks: Panama, Costa Rica, Nicaragua, Honduras
facts.head: Background

pages.title: Rare quadruple star system UPM J1040−3551 AabBab

facts.text: System: two cold T-type brown dwarfs orbiting a pair of young red dwarfs — ⚠ first such arrangement seen
facts.head: News

facts.text: Journal: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society (Sept 2025)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Led by: Prof. Zenghua Zhang, Nanjing University
facts.head: News

facts.text: Brown dwarfs: "failed stars" — cannot sustain hydrogen fusion; up to 70 times Jupiter's mass; companion chance <5%
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Red dwarfs: most common stars — ~70% of Milky Way stars; long-lived
facts.head: Background

facts.text: ⚠ Blue supergiants are among the hottest, most luminous stars — not cold
facts.head: Background

pages.title: Entangled atomic clocks to probe quantum–gravity interface

facts.text: Study: Jacob Covey, Igor Pikovski, Johannes Borregaard — in PRX Quantum (July 2025)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Proposal: tabletop experiment with three entangled ytterbium atomic clocks at different elevations (km-scale)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Entanglement: W state (robust to particle loss, unlike GHZ state)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Expected: frequency shift ~0.02 Hz for 1 km separation; coherence time ~50 seconds
facts.head: News

facts.text: Tests: unitarity, linearity, Born rule in curved spacetime
facts.head: News

facts.text: Quantum gravity theories: String Theory (extra dimensions, gravitons), Loop Quantum Gravity (discrete spacetime at Planck scale)
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Quantum mechanics vs general relativity — not yet unified
facts.head: Background
